title: AYE MERE BABA HUSSAIN AA JAAOO
body:
YEH SAKINA KEHTI THI KHOUFF SE ANDHERE KE
AYE MERE BABA HUSSAIN AA JAAOO
1. KAB SE SAKINA TUMHE BULAATI HAI
YAAD KYA HAMARI NAHI AATI HAI
GHAM SE MERI JAAN CHALI JAATI
HAI AAOO MERE DIL KE CHAIN AAJAO
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ZINDAGI MEIN TUMHE NA PAO MEIN
YAAD MEIN TUMHARI MARNA JAO MEIN
TUMKO KIS TARAH SE AB BULAO MEIN
ASHK BAR HAI YEH NAIN AAJAO
<<DIVIDER>>
3. AAP KYA PALAT KE NAHI AYENGE
AAP KE BINA NAHI RAH PAYENGE
HUM TADAP TADAP KE MAR HI JAYENGE
AAO SHAHE MASHRAQAIN AAJAO
<<DIVIDER>>
4. AAEE YE MADAD KO MERI BABA JAAN
DAS RAHA HAI MUJHKO ANDHERA ZINDAAN
AB TU NAKALI JAATI HAI BADAN SE JAAN
SUN BI LO HAMARE BAIYEN AAJAO
<<DIVIDER>>
5. KYA HAMARA ROONA AB GAWARA HAI
MUJH S3 KIYA ZYADA DHASHT PYAAR HAI
SUCH BAATAO KOUN AB HAMARA HAI
MUJH KO AB NAHI HAI CHAIN AAJAO
<<DIVIDER>>
6. SEENE PE MEIN AAP HI KE SOOTI THI
AAP SE JUDAA KABHI JO HOOTI THI
ROOTEY AAP JAB KABHI MEIN ROOTI THI
AAYE SHA E BADRO HUNAIN AAJAO
<<DIVIDER>>
7. AYE SOHAIL EK HASR THA BARPA JAB
JAWAAD PADH RAHA THA YEH NOUHA
KEH KE YEH SAKINA KARTI THI GIRYA
AYE MERE BABA HUSSAIN AAJAO
AZZ..RAZA ALI SOHAIL
